{"content": "import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

/-- `accEq` only returns `true` for equal accounts. -/
theorem accEq_sound : ∀ (a b : Account), accEq a b = true → a = b
  | [], [] => fun _ => rfl
  | [], _ :: _ => fun h => by cases h
  | _ :: _, [] => fun h => by cases h
  | a :: as, b :: bs => fun h => by
    have h1 : decide (a = b) && accEq as bs = true := h
    cases hd : decide (a = b)
    · have h2 : accEq as bs = true := h1
      exact congrArg (List.cons a) (accEq_sound as bs h2)
    · exact absurd h1 (by rw [hd]; intro hh; cases hh)

/-- If `isAllowed` returns `true`, the account is in the allowlist. -/
theorem isAllowed_sound (to : Account) :
    ∀ (l : List Account), isAllowed to l = true → to ∈ l
  | [], h => by cases h
  | a :: as, h => by
    have h' : accEq a to || isAllowed to as = true := h
    cases hb : accEq a to
    · have h2 : isAllowed to as = true := h'
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem a (isAllowed_sound to as h2)
    · have h2 : a = to := accEq_sound a to (of_decide_eq_true hb)
      exact h2 ▸ List.mem_cons_self (a := to) (l := as)

end Solution
"}
